module: luamqtt network connector for luasocket combined with copas (cooperative I/O in coroutines). Same interface as the luasocket connector (connect, shutdown, send, receive, settimeout) but send and receive go through copas.send/copas.receive. To be passed in the connector argument of the MQTT client.
notes: Uses require('copas') by bare name and require('socket'): these modules are not necessarily resolved under that name in BeamNG (the game provides libs/copas/copas).
settimeout puts the socket in non-blocking mode (settimeout(0)) and only stores the timeout in conn.timeout.

connect.desc: Opens the TCP connection via socket.connect and stores it in conn.sock.

settimeout.desc: Stores the timeout in conn.timeout and sets the socket to non-blocking.
